title: Every Mother
logline: One mother's ordinary day shows the quiet strength of mothers across our country.
audience: Family and friends watching on a phone (WhatsApp, Facebook, TikTok)
intent: Viewers feel respect and gratitude for the unseen daily work of mothers.
style_block: hand-painted illustration, soft painterly brush texture, gentle film grain, warm color palette, cinematic composition, subject centered in frame, no text, no letters

character.description: Ethiopian woman in her 40s, dark brown skin, kind tired eyes, a white cotton netela shawl over her hair, a simple modest long dress, strong gentle hands

narration.style_instruction: Say calmly, warmly and slowly, like a grown child remembering their mother

music.caption: gentle acoustic instrumental, soft piano and krar-like plucked strings, warm, slow, nostalgic, light texture, no strong lead melody

cues.role: builds gently, her calling and her burden

shots.reason: Faith comes first. Opens the hands motif.
shots.keyframe_prompt: The mother kneeling by a window in a dark room, her folded hands in front of her, first blue light of dawn on her face
shots.motion_prompt: very slow push-in, soft light slowly brightening
shots.narration: My mother wakes before the sun, and kneels to give her day to God.

shots.reason: Care that goes unseen: breakfast made while the family sleeps.
shots.keyframe_prompt: The mother in a simple Ethiopian kitchen preparing breakfast, bread and a clay coffee pot (jebena) with steam rising, soft morning light
shots.narration: Then the kitchen comes alive. Breakfast for all of us, made while we are still asleep.

shots.reason: A close-up of her hands carries the emotion. Hands motif.
shots.keyframe_prompt: Close-up of the mother's hands carefully wrapping injera with shiro in a cloth for a lunch, warm kitchen light
shots.motion_prompt: slow pan across her hands as they fold the cloth
shots.narration: She wraps my father's lunch the way she does everything: carefully, with her whole heart.

shots.reason: Changes the place and moves the story outdoors.
shots.keyframe_prompt: The mother seen from behind walking down an empty quiet Ethiopian neighborhood street toward a small church, soft morning mist
shots.motion_prompt: slow tracking follow, gentle camera drift
shots.narration: Then she walks to church, while the street is still yawning.

shots.reason: Shows her calling: she preaches, but mostly she listens.
shots.keyframe_prompt: Inside a small church room, the mother gently holding the hand of an older woman who is sad, both seated, warm window light
shots.motion_prompt: very slow push-in, soft dust floating in light
shots.narration: She is an evangelist. She preaches, but mostly she listens, to the ones nobody else has time for.

shots.reason: The emotional centre, and the clear transition from church to home (test 1 feedback).
shots.keyframe_prompt: The mother walking home slowly in golden evening light, her shoulders heavy, long shadow behind her, quiet street
shots.motion_prompt: slow pan following her, warm light
shots.narration: All day she carries other people's burdens. Then, as evening falls, she carries them home.

shots.reason: Shows resilience: no rest, straight back to work.
shots.keyframe_prompt: The mother in her home kitchen in simple house clothes, tying an apron, stirring a pot of shiro on the stove, evening light
shots.motion_prompt: slow push-in, steam rising from the pot
shots.narration: She walks in, changes her clothes, and goes straight back to the kitchen. Nobody asks her to. Nobody has to.

shots.reason: The edge: viewers see themselves in the family who never asks.
shots.keyframe_prompt: A family of four eating dinner together at a table, injera with shiro, warm lamp light, father, a teenage son and daughter laughing, the mother standing slightly behind serving
shots.motion_prompt: static camera, subtle warm light flicker
shots.narration: Dinner for her husband, her son, her daughter. We eat and laugh, and never ask how tired she is.

shots.reason: Contrast: everyone rests, she does not. Hands motif.
shots.keyframe_prompt: Close-up of the mother's hands washing dishes in a sink at night, the empty kitchen behind her, a single warm lamp
shots.narration: When we are done, she washes every dish and wipes every corner, until the kitchen is quiet again.

shots.reason: Closes the hands motif and widens the story to every mother.
shots.keyframe_prompt: The mother's folded hands in prayer beside a bed, soft lamp light, the family silhouettes praying behind her, calm and peaceful
shots.motion_prompt: very slow pull-back, lamp light dims
shots.narration: Then we pray together. And only then, she sleeps. My mother is one woman. But she is every mother in this country.
